notes.subject: בוש/הבישו/יבושו
notes.rationale: Motso o le mong wa ho tshwarela maleme o boeledwa makgetlo a mararo; sebopeho se timetse ka ho feletseng ka Sesotho.

notes.subject: יפלו/בנפלים
notes.rationale: Ho wa ho boeledwa — 'ba tla wa hara ba welang' — khutliso e bolokwa ka Sesotho.

notes.subject: הבישו
notes.rationale: Bongata bo bontsha nako e tlang (ba tla tshwara maleme, jwaloka JPS) mme bongata bo seng bo sheba nakong e fetileng kapa potso ('Na ba ne ba tshwerwe maleme?'); ke nakong e tlang jwaloka JPS.

notes.subject: הכלים
notes.rationale: 'Ba hlokomele' kgahlanong le 'ba tshwanetse ho ikutlwa mahlonong' — lentsoe le bolelang bohlonzi/hloeko ya sebopeho se sa bonahaleng ka Sesotho.

notes.subject: בעת פקדתים
notes.rationale: Nako ya ho etela ha Yahwe e behilwe kamoo e leng karolo ya kahlolo e itseng.

translation: Ba tshwere maleme hobane toeba ba e entse; le hoja ba a tshwara maleme, empa ba hlokomele hlole: ba tshwere maleme hape ba hloka ho tseba. Ka baka leo ba tla wa hara ba welang; ka nako ya ho etela ka kahlolo ba tla tsamaea ka metheo, ho bolela Yahwe.
